'''Johannes Henricus Bernardus Kemperman''' (July 16, 1924 – June 13, 2011) was a Dutch [[mathematician]]. He taught at the [[University of Rochester]] for 25 years, and also worked at [[Purdue University]] and [[Rutgers University]] for ten years, each.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://bulletin.imstat.org/2012/02/obituary-johannes-kemperman-1924%E2%80%932011/ |title=Obituary: Johannes Kemperman, 1924–2011 |access-date=2015-03-30 |archive-date=2015-04-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402122737/http://bulletin.imstat.org/2012/02/obituary-johannes-kemperman-1924%E2%80%932011/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Born in [[Amsterdam]], he received his education from the [[University of Amsterdam]].<ref>{{cite journal |last=Naus |first=Joseph I. |title=A conversation with Johannes H. B. Kemperman |journal=Statist. Sci. |volume=15 |issue=4 |year=2000 |pages=396–408 |url=http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.ss/1009213005 |doi=10.1214/ss/1009213005|doi-access=free }}</ref>
